payload.reason: The evidence indicates that among the three pretraining tasks, Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective for improving performance in abstractive summarization tasks.

claims.text: Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task, outperforming Next Sentence Generation (NSG) and Masked Document Generation (MDG).
SR consistently achieves the highest ROUGE-2 scores on summarization datasets, indicating its superior effectiveness in pre-training.
Using all three tasks together (ALL) can outperform individual tasks, but SR remains the best single task for pre-training.
